description: Award points to a participant for a challenge checkpoint. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

awardType.description: Size of the points award; use one of the allowed values.

challengeId.description: Challenge ID, from list_products or a challenge tool for this business.

checkpointId.description: Challenge checkpoint ID, from the challenge checkpoint list.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

participantId.description: Challenge participant ID, from a challenge participant listing.
